lyrics:
[Intro: solo piano, minor key, a music box phrase]

[Verse 1: female voice, quiet and hurt]
I learned to read a room before I learned to read
I learned the sound a key makes when it's angry
I learned to be the good one, be the small one
I learned which stair would creak, and how to hang back

[Pre-Chorus: strings enter, voice rising]
You gave me what they gave you
I know. I've seen the pictures.

[Chorus: full band, belted]
But it stops with me
I'm the end of that line
It stops with me
She will never learn to hide
I kept your eyes, I kept your laugh, I kept the lullaby
The rest of it stops with me

[Verse 2: voice steadier, drums in]
My daughter slams a door and I say, "Tell me"
She cries out loud, in public, in the car
She's never had to guess what kind of evening
She doesn't flinch. She doesn't know how far

[Pre-Chorus: strings, voice rising]
I had to go to get her this
It cost me. It was worth it.

[Chorus: full band, belted]
'Cause it stops with me
I'm the end of that line
It stops with me
She will never learn to hide
I kept your eyes, I kept your laugh, I kept the lullaby
The rest of it stops with me

[Bridge: piano and voice, nearly spoken]
I'm not angry anymore
You were a scared kid too
I just couldn't pass it on

[Final Chorus: major key, choir behind, highest note]
It stops with me
I'm the end of that line
It stops with me
Listen to her, laughing down the hall
I kept your eyes, I kept your laugh, I kept the lullaby
The rest of it stops with me

[Outro: music box phrase in a major key, a child laughing]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 70 BPM, 4/4, F minor, resolving to A-flat major in the final chorus. Slow, tense and building, then released.

VOICE: Female, a strong, emotional pop-rock voice. She sings the verses quietly with a tremor, and belts the choruses with full power and a slight rasp. The bridge is close to speech. A choir joins the final chorus.

INSTRUMENTS: Piano, a music-box-like celesta phrase, a string section, bass, a rock drum kit that enters at verse 2, distorted guitars low in the choruses, a choir.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, piano and music box. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:48 Pre-chorus. 0:58 Chorus 1. 1:28 Verse 2. 2:02 Pre-chorus. 2:12 Chorus 2. 2:42 Bridge. 3:02 Final chorus, major. 3:34 Outro, music box and laughter, ends 3:48.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2000s pop-rock ballad: dramatic and polished, piano and strings leading, drums and guitars swelling behind.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'I kept your eyes, I kept your laugh, I kept the lullaby' at 1:18.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is the injured child speaking. Twenty years later she is a mother herself, able to understand the parent, forgive what can be forgiven and report that the damage ended with her.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Wary, angry, understanding, free.
